description: This file defines a custom JSON serializer for Java Certificate objects, specifically handling X509Certificates, to serialize their properties into JSON format.

classes.name: CertificateSerializer
classes.description: A custom serializer extending Jackson's StdSerializer to convert Certificate objects, especially X509Certificates, into JSON format with detailed fields.

methods.name: CertificateSerializer
methods.description: Constructor initializing the serializer for Certificate class.

methods.name: serialize
methods.description: Serializes a Certificate object into JSON, extracting various certificate properties if it is an X509Certificate.

methods.name: writeCollection
methods.description: Helper method to write a collection of items as a JSON array.

methods.name: writeCollectionOfLists
methods.description: Helper method to write a collection of lists of strings as a JSON array.
